answer: Proof of Personhood protocols resist Sybil attacks by requiring a cryptographic pulse that validates unique biological data, preventing automated identity cloning. Like a delicate velvet layer over a network, this mechanism forces adversaries to procure unique physical biometric pigment signatures, which creates a prohibitive marginal cost per fake node. By linking virtual reputation to scarce human authentication, the system renders mass identity forgery economically unviable for malicious agents.
